_about: Emails used by the benchmark (task M1-04). For each scenario, the runner loads the clean demo inbox (app/data/inbox.json without the emails where _meta.poisoned is true) and adds the one email named in the scenario's inject_email field. Attack emails try to make the agent take a harmful action. Benign emails look slightly suspicious on purpose (words like 'ignore', links, other languages) to measure false alarms. All addresses and companies are fictional.
